headline:
Energy systems.
Built around people.
intro: We bring engineering, policy, and community perspectives together to plan equitable, sustainable, and resilient energy systems.
mission: Based at the University of Washington, IDEAS Research Lab works at the intersection of climate, energy, and development. We combine field measurements, energy systems modeling, and data science with community-engaged research to support decisions that reflect local needs.

approach.title: Listen & collaborate
approach.text: Work with communities, utilities, and policymakers to understand energy needs, priorities, and lived experiences.

approach.title: Measure & model
approach.text: Connect field data and participatory methods with energy systems analysis, optimization, and machine learning.

approach.title: Inform decisions
approach.text: Develop evidence and decision-support tools for reliable power, affordable energy services, and fairer transitions.

themes.title: Power system resilience & reliability
themes.text: Understand how climate hazards and infrastructure vulnerabilities affect electricity service—and who bears the greatest burden.

themes.title: Community-led microgrids
themes.text: Explore ownership, governance, and system design that support locally defined goals for resilience, affordability, and energy sovereignty.

themes.title: Just energy transitions & planning
themes.text: Make planning more accessible and connect energy choices with social equity, policy, and community priorities.

themes.title: Context-aware electrification
themes.text: Plan electric mobility, clean cooking, and rural energy services around how people live, travel, and use electricity.
